lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima arranged in a grid-like distribution across the central lateral region, posterior to the branchial area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Low-contrast vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that coincide with the centroids of the circular high-luminance clusters on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features with a high-contrast luminance gradient (light superior, dark inferior) running longitudinally along the upper third of the visible flank.
